name: ai-char-engine
description: Interactive evidence-grounded persistent character engine for Codex image generation with optional local ComfyUI.

interface.shortDescription: Create and keep one visual character consistent.
interface.longDescription: A conversational Codex workflow that guides non-technical users from a new character or unlimited reference photos, builds an evidence-grounded identity brain, lets the user choose local ComfyUI, Codex image generation, or automatic routing, and produces consistent photorealistic images with bounded context and repair cost.
defaultPrompt: Help me create a new persistent character from scratch.
I already have a character. Guide me through adding reference photos.
Generate a new photo of my saved character and ask which image backend I want when needed.
Set up local ComfyUI image generation for AI Character Engine.
Update this repository to the latest AI Character Engine plugin and register it for Codex automatically.
